constraints.text: A utility vault at the landing and a catch basin in the ramp area may limit the layout.
Pooling water is recorded at the base of the ramp, so drainage needs review.

options.rationale: A parallel layout could move the landing away from the recorded vault, if a site check confirms the vault's location. The city's guide says DOT approval may be needed for this type.
A blended transition is another possibility, if the street grade allows it. The street grade at the corner still needs checking.
